title: Montgomery GI Bill Selected Reserves Tuition Fairness Act of 2025
short_title: Montgomery GI Bill Selected Reserves Tuition Fairness Act of 2025
committees: H-Veterans' Affairs Committee: Bills of Interest - Exchange of Letters  -> Referred To 2025-02-05 [Economic Opportunity Subcommittee: Referred 2025-03-07] || H-Armed Services Committee: Bills of Interest - Exchange of Letters  -> Referred To 2025-02-05 || S-Veterans' Affairs Committee: Referred To 2025-04-08 -> Discharged From 2025-11-20
summary: Montgomery GI Bill Selected Reserves Tuition Fairness Act of 2025 This act requires that the Department of Veterans Affairs disapprove courses of education provided by educational institutions that charge higher than in-state tuition for individuals utilizing the Montgomery GI Bill-Selected Reserve education benefits while living in the state where the education is located, regardless of the individual’s state of residence.
